extracted.intended_audience: readers/subscribers of The Popular Science Monthly: scientists, students, and educated general readers interested in scientific and literary book reviews
extracted.subtask_description: Evaluative standards and criteria used in short literary notices and reviews of scientific, educational, and general-interest books appearing in a 19th-century popular-science magazine. Focuses on qualities reviewers cite when judging books (clarity, accuracy, scope, usefulness, illustrations, price, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Accuracy and completeness of content
rubrics_metrics.description: The work should realize the qualities of 'accuracy and completeness' without exaggeration in concision or overabundance of detail; definitions and factual statements should be 'satisfactorily full.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pay attention to etymologies and full definitions (as in the dictionary example). Avoid excessive brevity that sacrifices correctness and avoid overwhelming the reader with unnecessary detail.

rubrics_metrics.name: Suitability to target reader level (beginner vs. advanced)
rubrics_metrics.description: The book must be suited to its intended audience — e.g., 'very strong claims upon the biological student; but for the beginner... it is incomparable' — and explicit about whether it is a handbook for self-instruction or a textbook.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make clear whether material is introductory or advanced; omit or include generalizations appropriately (beginners: focus on facts and observation; advanced: include synthesis and theory).

rubrics_metrics.name: Practical usefulness / applicability
rubrics_metrics.description: The work should 'supply a want' and 'be generally useful to' its intended users (travelers, laboratory chemists, students), providing information the reader is likely to need in practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasize concrete, usable information (methods, guides, tables) and judge whether the book accomplishes its practical aims (e.g., 'indispensable to the laboratory').

rubrics_metrics.name: Clarity and lucidity of exposition
rubrics_metrics.description: Exposition should be lucid, inviting, and clear — e.g., 'wonderful clearness of statement', 'clearness, directness, and simplicity' — making complex subjects readable to various classes of readers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate prose clarity, the order of explanations, and the author's skill in making difficult material accessible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appropriate scope and selectivity (coverage)
rubrics_metrics.description: Scope must fit the book's purpose; coverage should be sufficient without being excessive ('cover wide zoological ground' yet not attempt exhaustive generalization). Curation should prune mediocre material ('catalogue is too full').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess whether the breadth matches the stated objective and whether the list/coverage needs pruning for usefulness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organization, structure, and integration
rubrics_metrics.description: Material should be well organized (chapters, tables, appendices) and integrated (illustrations referenced in text; tables serving clear purposes). Poor ordering reduces value ('illustrations... lose a large part of their value by being inserted without reference to the text').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check chapter arrangement, table functions, and whether figures/plates are placed and referenced to support the text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality and placement of illustrations
rubrics_metrics.description: Illustrations should be well executed and placed so they support the text ('illustrations... fairly well but not finely executed' and 'lose a large part of their value by being inserted without reference to the text').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Judge technical quality of cuts/photographs/engravings and whether they are captioned/located where readers can use them alongside the relevant passages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rigor, reliability, and novelty of methods
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural or analytical methods presented should be reliable, up-to-date, and, if novel, clearly described (e.g., 'new methods of analysis', 'best methods known at present for detecting oleomargarine').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess whether methods are clearly given, justified, and whether they improve upon or correct existing practices; note methodological caveats and limitations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality of data sources and empirical procurement
rubrics_metrics.description: Data and statistics should be based on sound sources and procurement methods ('information... procured, so far as possible, directly from the producers... gives a nearer approach to accuracy').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate primary-source use, transparency of data collection, and the limits of completeness (e.g., missing small producers).

rubrics_metrics.name: Value for money / affordability given quality
rubrics_metrics.description: Price should be fair relative to usefulness, elegance, and uniqueness ('published at a very low price... considering its cost and elegance').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider production quality and uniqueness relative to cost when judging the book's accessibility and likely demand.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authoritativeness, citation, and verification
rubrics_metrics.description: The work should demonstrate authority (experience, examined papers, consulted experts) and transparent verification of sources ('all the papers quoted have been examined by the author personally').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check for explicit statements about how sources were gathered and whether the author relied on personal experience or third-party material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alignment between stated purpose and execution
rubrics_metrics.description: The book must fulfill the purpose announced by the author or editor (e.g., a guide to a railway region should give a 'good general idea' of the territory; tables should enable identification with 'as few easy tests as possible').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate whether the content matches the declared aims and whether deviations (scope changes, broadened intent) affect utility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Balanced treatment and discrimination in argument
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors should exercise 'discrimination' and avoid exaggerated assertions or overbroad claims (e.g., avoid treating 'art' as if its subservience to virtue were universally applicable).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Look for measured arguments, acknowledgement of complexities, and avoidance of sweeping generalizations or rhetorical overstatement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Usefulness of supplementary materials (tables, appendices, classifications)
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendices and tables should supply distinguishing information and practical aids (e.g., tables for mineral determination, appendices giving distinctions between allied species).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess how well supplementary material supports practical use and whether it compresses needed information effectively.

rubrics_metrics.name: Presentation, typography, and page layout for readability
rubrics_metrics.description: Typographic choices (columns, bold-face headings) and compact, clear letter-press assist daily use ('arranged in four columns to the page, the words are printed in bold-face type to catch the eye readily').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Judge readability, typographic clarity, and whether layout choices make the work easier to consult.

rubrics_metrics.name: Originality and contribution to the field
rubrics_metrics.description: The book should advance knowledge or practice (e.g., Tyndall's work 'has made very important contributions' to germ theory; King's report offers closer accuracy by novel data procurement).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate whether the work presents new results, methods, or syntheses that materially move the field forward.

rubrics_metrics.name: Precision and practicality of step-by-step instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical manuals should give explicit, careful procedures and cautions (e.g., stepwise directions for obtaining amoebae, warnings to avoid disturbing mud, keep separate bottles).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check for precise quantities, timings, cautions, and tips that enable a novice to reproduce the procedure successfully.
